items.title: 7.6 Ethical Issues in Data Science and Analysis

source_refs.note: Topic 7.6 as printed before its first sub-heading (PDF 101-101, printed 97-97); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Ethical issues are a major concern in data science and data analysis. As data is collected and analyzed on a large scale, it must be handled responsibly. Ethical practices ensure fairness, accuracy, and trust in data-driven decisions. Poor ethical standards can lead to the misuse of data and harm individuals or groups. Data scientists must follow ethical guidelines while collecting, processing, and interpreting data. Transparency and accountability are essential in every stage of data analysis. Ethical awareness helps maintain public confidence in data science applications.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Biased data can produce unfair results. Ethical data science protects privacy and avoids discrimination. Responsible data use builds trust in technology.
